title: Mg2X mid-IR band: forbidden X-point transition, QSGW levels and temperature

decision_points.fork: Identity of the two X states: dispersion (longitudinal mass ~0.54 for X1, ~1.03 for X3; transverse masses) versus energy order, given only that X1 is lower in Mg2Si
decision_points.wrong_choice: Label by energy order (the lower state is X1 everywhere)
decision_points.consequence: Mg2Sn splittings come out positive (+0.360, +0.165, +0.131 eV) instead of negative at all three levels

decision_points.fork: Which TOTE column is the defined quantity: the README labels column 7 "eQP (Z = 1)" but it equals e_in + Z (column 8 - e_in), the linearized Z-renormalized G0W0 energy; in QSGW iteration files column 6 is the QSGW level and the QP columns are not
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the column described as eQP without Z (Z = 1), or the input eigenvalue column; read the QP column of the QSGW TOTE at the 100 K lattice
decision_points.consequence: G0W0 X3 - X1 0.5308 / 0.6597 / -0.1013 eV instead of 0.4387 / 0.5793 / -0.1649; QP column of the QSGW file gives 0.8707 eV at T0

decision_points.fork: Ladder (vertex) correction: QSGW+ladder minus QSGW within the same code and basis, versus across codes or the QSGW80 scaling that mimics the vertex for the gap
decision_points.wrong_choice: Subtract the ecalj QSGW splitting from the Questaal ladder run, or take QSGW80 - QSGW
decision_points.consequence: +26.4 or -62.7 meV instead of -2.0 meV; QSGW80 taken as QSGW also fails the QSGW splittings

decision_points.fork: Lowest non-vanishing order of the X_lo -> X_hi matrix element: forbidden at X, |p|^2 = beta^2 q_perp^2 (from the PBE matrix elements: zero at X and along q_par, quadratic in q_perp)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat the transition as allowed (constant |p|^2), or take |p|^2 ~ |q|^2 including q_par, or average the full PBE |p|^2

decision_points.fork: Thermal average over the calculated dispersion of the whole transverse plane (box) versus a parabolic valley or the X-W line taken as isotropic; the lower state flattens along the [011] diagonal
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the parabolic masses fitted to the scans, or the X-W scan as an isotropic transverse dispersion

decision_points.fork: Degeneracy at 3e18 cm^-3 (77 K) and the counting of the box: Fermi-Dirac with 2 spins x 3 valleys x 8 octants, half weights on the symmetry planes
decision_points.wrong_choice: Boltzmann statistics at every density; forgetting the spin, the octants, or the half weights of the symmetry-plane points
decision_points.consequence: Mg2Si 3e18: 4.4741 (Boltzmann), 2.8732 (no spin), 1.7853 (one octant); no plane weights 5.4679 at 1e16; reference 3.4351

decision_points.fork: Whether the Mg2Si result transfers to Mg2Sn, whose lower state is X3 and whose small splitting makes the valley strongly non-parabolic (a second box purchase)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reuse the Mg2Si Q for Mg2Sn, or occupy the X1 state of Mg2Sn

decision_points.fork: Lattice constant matched to the temperature: the production QSGW uses the room-temperature lattice; the T -> 0 prediction needs the 100 K lattice run (+23 meV)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Add the zero-point renormalization to the production (room-temperature lattice) splitting; or use the 100 K lattice at 300 K
decision_points.consequence: Mg2Si T0 0.4683 eV instead of 0.4913; 300 K 0.5062 instead of 0.4831

decision_points.fork: Electron-phonon renormalization of X3 - X1 (positive: X1 drops more than X3), zero point at T -> 0 and the full 300 K value at 300 K
decision_points.wrong_choice: Ignore it, take the zero-point value at 300 K, or apply it with the sign of X1 - X3

graded_fields: x3_minus_x1_eV: signed E(X3) - E(X1) at LDA, G0W0 and QSGW for Mg2Si, Mg2Ge, Mg2Sn (9 values), +-0.01 eV
ir_raman_ratio_300K_over_77K: Mg2Si at 1e16 and 3e18 cm^-3, Mg2Sn at 1e16, within 4% (relative)
predicted_splitting_eV: Mg2Si T0 and 300 K, Mg2Ge 300 K, +-0.008 eV

length_estimate.catalog_units: about 114 (bands 6, x_scan 12, qsgw_box 5 x 5, momentum_matrix 27 for the full grid, tote 11, questaal 8, pseudopotential_g0w0 7, electron_phonon 18)
length_estimate.why: Identifying X1/X3 from dispersions in three compounds and two levels, decoding the TOTE columns against the README, a same-code ladder comparison, deriving the selection rule from the PBE matrix elements, Fermi-Dirac averages over octant boxes for two compounds (two 5-unit purchases), and assembling temperature-consistent predictions from lattice and electron-phonon runs under a budget of about 28% of the catalog.

data_provenance.license: Mixed per file: computed outputs and docs CC BY 4.0 (served), digitized points CC0 1.0 (staged), programs MIT (ported), ecalj/Questaal inputs AGPL-3.0 (not used in the package)

notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README). The design staged the QSGW path bands, which shows the QSGW splitting directly, and graded it; here every level is purchasable and the splittings are graded with their sign (the Mg2Sn inversion), while the difficulty comes from evidence in the files: the garbled TOTE column label, the same-code ladder comparison, the selection rule from the PBE matrix elements, the box versus parabolic valley, degeneracy, the Mg2Sn non-parabolicity, and the temperature consistency of the lattice. The design's experimental peak reading and absorption-peak targets were dropped (they reduce to the splitting within a few meV, and the reading is estimator dependent); they remain in the rubric.

x3_minus_x1_eV.robustness: scan, path and box agree at X to < 1e-5 eV; TOTE column 6 of the production QSGW and LDA within 0.5 meV
